name: @argo/desktop
description: Argo cockpit on Electron. Scaffold under migration; a packaged node-pty acceptance run is its gate.

scripts.prototype:composer: VITE_COMPOSER_PROTOTYPE=1 node ../../scripts/node-version-gate.mjs && node scripts/link-hoisted-electron.mjs && electron-forge start
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.fake-drivers.json
scripts.build:fake-drivers: bun build src/core/projects/fake-driver/prove-project-contract.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --external=playwright-core --external=chromium-bidi --outfile=scripts/project-fake-driver/prove-project-contract.mjs && bun build src/core/projects/fake-driver/capture-cockpit.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --external=playwright-core --external=chromium-bidi --outfile=scripts/project-fake-driver/capture-cockpit.mjs && bun build src/core/projects/fake-driver/measure-cockpit.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --external=playwright-core --external=chromium-bidi --outfile=scripts/project-fake-driver/measure-cockpit.mjs && bun build src/core/sessions/fake-driver/prove-session-feed.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --external=playwright-core --external=chromium-bidi --outfile=scripts/session-fake-driver/prove-session-feed.mjs
